sources.text: Synthetic packet: The initial recovery packet includes an ineligible subordinate and a foreign-currency obligation; quotes are not interchangeable.

Synthetic governing terms: The synthetic contract settles protection using the minimum eligible quotation among senior USD obligations published by cutoff. This is a stipulated auction rule, not a general auction model. Protection pays hedge_face*(1-recovery_price/100); the held bond pays bond_face*recovery_price/100. Both receipts are certain conditional on this scenario, but cash is usable only on its payment day. No discounting, interest or transfers; all cash amounts are USD millions. The input basis is the historical bond purchase price per 100 face, not a cash amount. Historical bond cost in USD millions equals bond_face*basis/100; premium is already a USD-million cash amount.
